title: CODATA 2022: the fine-structure constant is 7.297 352 5643 × 10⁻³
summary: The inverse is printed as 137.035 999 177. Neither is marked exact.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'fine-structure constant 7.297 352 5643 e-3' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 0011 e-3', and 'inverse fine-structure constant 137.035 999 177' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 021'. Neither line is marked exact. The fine-structure constant is a measured coupling, not one of the seven numbers BIPM fixed in 2019.
